ALLEGHENY AIRLINES
DC-9
SEAT BELTS
Please keep your seat belt fastened when the seat belt sign is on. When the seat
belt sign is turned off in flight, we suggest you keep your seat belt fastened
while seated.
SEAT BACKS & SEAT TRAYS
Federal air regulations require that you place your seat and seat tray in an
upright position for all takeoffs and landings.
NO SMOKING
When the no smoking sign is on, extinguish all smoking material. Visable fluid
lighters are not permitted to be used on the aircraft.
PORTABLE ELECTRONIC EQUIPMENT
AM, FM, and TV receivers may not be used during flight. These devices may
disturb the navigational aids of the aircraft.
FLOTATION CUSHION
Your seat cushion is
designed to float.
Grasp seat cushion and
pull up.
PROTECTIVE POSITION
Leave aircraft. Hold
on to straps to keep
afloat.
REAR FACING SEAT
FORWARD FACING SEAT
Remove eyeglasses and
sharp objects from
pockets. Fasten seat
belt tight and low
across hips.
Clasp hands firmly
behind head.
Lean back in seat.
Lean forward and down
as far as possible.
Clasp hands firmly
under legs.
OXYGEN SYSTEM
Individual oxygen
masks stored in
overhead panel.
Panel opens auto-
matically. Pull
mask down.
(OVER)
Place mask over mouth
and nose. Hook strap
over head. Breathe
normally.

EMERGENCY EXIT INFORMATION
PLEASE ACQUAINT YOURSELVES WITH THE SAFETY FEATURES
LOCATED ON THIS AIRCRAFT.
SHOULD IT BE NECESSARY TO
EVACUATE THE AIRCRAFT BECAUSE OF AN EMERGENCY, THE
DIAGRAMS BELOW ILLUSTRATE THE NUMBER OF EXITS FOR YOUR
USE.
